question: By what means has the complete teaching been fully revealed in this tantra?
premises: A question was posed by the interlocutor.
The present tantra serves as the locus of revelation.
The teaching referred to is presented as entirely revealed.
inference: Therefore, the interlocutor's question has occasioned the full revelation of that complete teaching in this tantra.
plain_english: By your question, all of that has been clearly revealed in this tantra.
